title: Custom export option with `PROPERTY_USAGE_SECRET` becomes invisible after project reload
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in 4.7 stable - Reproducible in latest main ### System information Godot v4.7.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7640) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-11400H @ 2.70GHz (12 threads) - 15.78 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description A custom EditorExportPlugin can add an export option with usage set to `PROPERTY_USAGE_SECRET`. This saves the export option to `.godot/export_credentials.cfg` as mentioned [here](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/export/exporting_projects.html#configuration-files). This can be done with the following sample code: ```gdscript @tool extends EditorPlugin class ExportPlugin extends EditorExportPlugin: func _supports_platform(platform: EditorExportPlatform) -> bool: return true func _get_export_options(platform: EditorExportPlatform) -> Array[Dictionary]: return [ { "option": { "name": "key", "type": TYPE_STRING, "usage": PROPERTY_USAGE_DEFAULT | PROPERTY_USAGE_SECRET, }, "default_value": "", } ] var _export_plugin : ExportPlugin func _enter_tree() -> void: if _export_plugin: remove_export_plugin(_export_plugin) _export_plugin = ExportPlugin.new() add_export_plugin(_export_plugin) func _exit_tree() -> void: if _export_plugin: remove_export_plugin(_export_plugin) _export_plugin = null ``` However, the value of this export option will become invisible in the export window in subsequent reloads of the project. The value is still stored correctly in `.godot/export_credentials.cfg` but the value won't show up. This is because when the editor loads the config when the project is opened, the export plugin hasn't added its export options yet, so `preset->get_properties()` doesn't contain the export option and the code doesn't copy the value over from the credentials data to the preset data. https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/56d440ff546f1a4bf3a120d7136969f11964aea3/editor/export/editor_export.cpp#L431-L438 ### Steps to reproduce 1. Launch the MRP in editor. 2. Go to "Project > Export..." and open the export dialog. 3. Add an export preset. Any export preset will do. (Here I used the Web export preset) 4. Set the "Key" export option to an arbitrary value, like this: 5. Reload the project. 6. Go to the export dialog again and observe that the "Key" export option is empty again. 7. Open `.godot/export_credentials.cfg` and confirm that the export option is still stored in the credentials file. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [mrp-secret-export-option.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29806989/mrp-secret-export-option.zip)
